style.vernacular: Abia State capital and former Biafran capital on the Port Harcourt-Enugu rail line, with colonial railway-era brick and corrugated-roof buildings, and newer state-built government blocks in cream and white painted-render around Ogurube, plus 1-3 storey shops and houses with rust and green metal roofs, red laterite earth, oil palms and broadleaf trees under a monsoon climate.
style.ornament: Pillared porches and balustraded balconies on Igbo storey houses; painted murals and uli-style motifs; colonial-era railway brick and verandas; Biafran war memorials, bunkers and displayed weapons; large Pentecostal and mission churches with gable fronts and towers.
